decision: Second credential file client-token, not the web token
why: The web token is printed in the host log and the browser address bar (ADR-0004); the socket credential should never leave its file

decision: Keep src/host/web-token.ts file name, export loadToken/removeToken/tokenPath/tokenMatches keyed by TokenFile union
why: Renaming the file would conflict with the feature stack that imports it; a union type keeps callers from inventing a third file name

decision: Host.start loads client-token inside the try after web.listen
why: A second just host that dies on a busy port must not rewrite the running host's credential
evidence: mutation: moving loadToken before web.listen fails test '网页端口被占用、宿主起不来时，不创建 client-token'

decision: Separate src/cli/client-token-rotate.ts instead of one rotate script with an argument
why: tests/host-main.test.ts and justfile already name web-token-rotate.ts; six lines is cheaper than a CLI arg parser
evidence: tests/socket-auth.test.ts rotate test red: ENOENT client-token then MODULE missing

decision: HostServer takes the credential at listen(path, clientToken)
why: No connection exists before listen, so the server can never run without a credential, and Host.start can load the file after the web port binds
evidence: tests/socket-auth.test.ts: 4 refused-hello cases red (got snapshot+ack) before the check

decision: Any non-worker hello needs the credential, including unknown role names
why: The old code mapped every non-worker role to client; keeping that mapping without the check would leave role:admin as a bypass
evidence: test 'client hello 用别的角色名、不带凭据' red then green

decision: Clients read dirname(socketPath)/client-token on every open()
why: Callers keep passing only socketPath; a rotated credential is picked up on reconnect; one state dir's credential never goes to another socket
evidence: host-first step: 14 existing client/ask/stories tests red until HostConnection sent the token; reconnect-after-rotate test green

decision: Added optional HostConnection.onError, wired to a TUI warning, said once per distinct message
why: Without it a TUI opened against a pre-upgrade host shows only 未连接，重试中 forever; the brief asks for a one-line error naming just host
evidence: tests/client.test.ts 'TUI：状态目录里没有 client-token 时提醒一次' red with the wiring line removed
result: green; differs from brief: one new optional callback

decision: HostConnection.connected still flips true on socket connect, before the host accepts hello
why: Moving it to first snapshot changes semantics many tests and scripted hosts rely on; a wrong-but-present file only happens after a manual edit
result: accepted: TUI status flaps each retry in that state

why: A watchdog-started host carries it and both the worker process and module prepare inherited it; nothing a worker runs reads it (grep: only host/CLI code and modules/toy-market/feed.ts, a user command)
evidence: tests/pi-worker-env.test.ts new test red: 'Worker 环境里不该有 PSA_STATE_DIR'

decision: Tool-command environment test is a characterization test
why: src/worker/extension.ts already deletes every PSA_ variable after reading them, so the test passed on first run
evidence: mutation: deleting that line fails 'Worker 的工具跑的命令，环境里没有任何 PSA_ 变量'; restored
result: green; no production change in extension.ts

decision: PSA_SOCKET stays in the worker process environment
why: The worker extension needs it to reach the host; its directory is the state directory, which is the limit ADR-0007 states
evidence: test asserts env.PSA_SOCKET is still set and no value contains 'client-token' or the credential

decision: Refused-hello log line is written at most once a minute
why: A TUI left open across the upgrade runs old code, retries every second without the credential, and would add about 86000 lines a day to host.log
evidence: tests/socket-auth.test.ts '升级前就开着的旧客户端…只记一行' red: 5 !== 1
result: green; differs from brief item 3 (one line per refusal)

decision: Accepted comment-sicko: 11 comment lines deleted, 4 renames (loadOrCreateToken, clientTokenBeside, #reportOnce/#lastReported, CREDENTIAL_DIR_NAME)
why: The names now say what the deleted comments said; the justfile comment was hiding the host recipe text in just --list
